/nix/store/ywl128arx1wk4qyyafgn0vmx63ci1azd-gleam-1.19.2/bin/gleam deps download
# Native compiler cache metadata records source mtimes.
find . -type f -exec touch -d @1 {} +
/nix/store/ywl128arx1wk4qyyafgn0vmx63ci1azd-gleam-1.19.2/bin/gleam build --target erlang
/nix/store/ywl128arx1wk4qyyafgn0vmx63ci1azd-gleam-1.19.2/bin/gleam test --target erlang
# Incremental caches serialize unordered compiler maps; runtime outputs
# live alongside them and remain intact.
find build -type f \( -name '*.cache' -o -name '*.cache_meta' \) -delete
cp -r . "$out/"
env.name: purified-gleam-project
